set autocommit=1

SELECT a.id,CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.props,CONCAT('$.access.roots.anchors."',?,'"')))='INTEGER' THEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.props,CONCAT('$.access.roots.anchors."',?,'"'))) AS SIGNED) ELSE NULL END AS root_grant,CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.props,'$.access.all'))='INTEGER' THEN CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.props,'$.access.all')) AS SIGNED) ELSE -1 END AS all_grant FROM anchors a WHERE a.kind='NodeAnchor' AND a.arch_type='Root' AND (JSON_EXTRACT(a.props,CONCAT('$.access.roots.anchors."',?,'"')) IS NOT NULL OR JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.props,'$.access.all'))='INTEGER')

SELECT * FROM (SELECT n1.id, n1.root_id, n1.acl_all, n1.acl_spec, n1.frag, n1.f_created_at, f0.ord AS _tk1, e1.seq AS _tk2, e1.id AS _tk3 FROM (SELECT ? AS id, 1 AS ord) AS f0 LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = ? OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = ? OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))))) JOIN g_n_profile_d2a57d n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND CASE WHEN n1.root_id = ? THEN true WHEN n1.acl_spec THEN true WHEN n1.root_id = ? THEN true WHEN n1.root_id IN (NULL) THEN true WHEN n1.root_id IN (NULL) THEN false ELSE n1.acl_all >= 0 END ORDER BY n1.f_created_at DESC, f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id LIMIT ?) _topk ORDER BY _tk1, _tk2, _tk3

SELECT * FROM (SELECT n2.id, n2.root_id, n2.acl_all, n2.acl_spec, n2.frag, n2.f_created_at, f0.ord AS _tk1, e1.seq AS _tk2, e1.id AS _tk3, e2.seq AS _tk4, e2.id AS _tk5 FROM (SELECT ? AS id, 1 AS ord) AS f0 LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = ? OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = ? OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))))) AND (e1.arch_type = ? OR e1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = ? OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)) JOIN anchors e2 ON e2.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e2.src = n1.id AND (e2.dst_type IS NULL OR (e2.dst_type = ? OR e2.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))) OR (e2.undirected AND (e2.dst = n1.id AND (e2.src_type IS NULL OR (e2.src_type = ? OR e2.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = ?)))))) JOIN g_n_tweet_d2a57d n2 ON n2.id = CASE WHEN e2.src = n1.id THEN e2.dst ELSE e2.src END AND CASE WHEN n2.root_id = ? THEN true WHEN n2.acl_spec THEN true WHEN n2.root_id = ? THEN true WHEN n2.root_id IN (NULL) THEN true WHEN n2.root_id IN (NULL) THEN false ELSE n2.acl_all >= 0 END ORDER BY n2.f_created_at DESC, f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id, e2.seq, e2.id LIMIT ?) _topk ORDER BY _tk1, _tk2, _tk3, _tk4, _tk5
